_meta.method: Web search plus direct page reads (WebFetch). Figures are as printed on the cited page on the retrieval date. 'primary' means the lender, operator or tax authority itself published it; 'secondary' means a broker, marketplace, press outlet or guide. 'confirmed' is true only when the figure was read directly on the cited page; false when it came from a search-engine summary or the page could not be opened.
caveats: No figure here was invented. Where a lender or operator does not print a figure, the value is null with a note.
Broker hourly rates are asking or 'from' rates that exclude positioning, landing, handling, de-icing and taxes unless stated.
Marketplace listings (GetMyBoat, OnBoat, Viator) change daily; treat them as dated snapshots.

statements.discount: Sometimes up to 75% less than a regular private charter fare; 25-75% cheaper depending on the flight.

statements.fixed: Aircraft type, departure date and time, and destination are predetermined.
statements.cancellation: If the original flight is canceled, the empty leg is no longer available and the passenger has to make other plans at the last minute; final details may not be known until just before departure.

statements.fixed: The aircraft type is fixed and cannot be swapped.

statements.lastMinute: Within 24 hours of a needed repositioning with no buyer, owners sometimes accept almost any reasonable offer.

lightJetUnder5_7t.statement: APD applies only to fixed-wing aircraft of 5.7 tonnes or more; a light jet under 5.7 t MTOW (e.g., Citation Mustang, most CJ1-CJ2, Phenom 100) is outside APD.

sources.text: Registration is required to operate a fixed-wing plane from a UK airport that weighs 5.7 tonnes or more.

higherRateCurrent.appliesTo: Aircraft of 20 tonnes or more equipped to carry fewer than 19 passengers
higherRateCurrent.note: Universal Weather's Dec 2025 guide gives £84 for band A higher, which is the 2025-26 figure; the GOV.UK table read on 2026-09-30 shows £142 from 1 April 2026 (consistent with the Autumn Budget 2024's 13% rise plus a further 50% for private jets). Domestic APD is charged on the departing leg only for a UK return trip.

changeFromApril2027.statement: From April 2027 the higher rate will apply to aircraft of 5.7 tonnes or more used as a private or business jet.
changeFromApril2027.note: Light jets under 5.7 t stay outside APD after the change.

vat.rule: UK passenger transport is zero-rated only in an aircraft designed or adapted to carry not less than 10 passengers; smaller aircraft (all light jets) are standard-rated at 20% for UK domestic flights. International legs are zero-rated as international transport.
vat.publisher: HMRC VAT Notice 744A (as reproduced by Croner-i)
vat.note: Threshold confirmed from search summaries of Notice 744A; GOV.UK page not read directly. The international zero-rating clause is from general knowledge of Notice 744A and should be verified.

iva.internationalRule: For international air transport, only 25% of the service counts as supplied in Mexico and is taxed at 16%; the other 75% is at 0% (Ley del IVA art. 16 and art. 29).
